title: NTLSN — National Teaching and Learning Sector Network
description: A free, open national commons mapping the Australian higher-education teaching and learning sector: events, symposia and professional development across all 43 universities; the rescued ALTC/OLT archive of 1,431 funded works; the SoTL Index and its DORA-aligned, describe-don't-rank methodology; a national library remote-access map; and CORS-open datasets, calendar and RSS feeds, and a machine-readable endpoint. Free at the point of use.
notes: The MIT licence covers the source code. Data and methodology are CC BY 4.0 and written content CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, with First Nations Indigenous Cultural and Intellectual Property excluded from every licence grant — see LICENSE, icip.html and docs/licensing-rationale.md.
